text.content:
18 January 843 AC

Dear Jimmel,

I hope this letter finds you well, although it bears sad news. It is my
unhappy duty to inform you that your mother passed away last year. You
are the last remaining of your line. Before she passed in her illness,
she asked that I relay to you that you might obtain your birthright at
your family’s old estate on the southeastern shores of Gravestone Lake.
She did caution that the estate was old and no one had lived there for a
few hundred years.

I am sorry for your loss and hope that you are doing well in your
journeys.

May Aslan guide your path,

Abbot Rupert Bailey

Yemthas Monastery

Skyefyre

Requires attunement

+1 Bow

+5 movement speed

3x charges/day

- fire a two arrows at the same target (straight roll)

OR

- fire two arrows at two different targets with a -3 modifier to hit
each target in the same attack.

GM note: the dedicated Skyefyre item document controls the bow’s mechanics where this letter’s appended shorthand differs.
